assertions.title: api route guard inventory does not declare unknown endpoints ready, including endpoints under the auth prefix
api route guard inventory recognizes the authenticated session claims route without exempting the entire auth prefix
api route guard inventory classifies tenant, public, upload, and receipt evidence in report mode
api route guard inventory describes report, warn, and fail inventory modes accurately
api route guard inventory returns a failing gate result in fail mode when active issues exist
api route guard inventory fails the CLI in fail mode when inventory issues exist
api route guard inventory passes the CLI in fail mode when inventory is clean
api route guard inventory does not flag inventory item APIs once module entitlement is enforced
api route guard inventory does not flag receipt routes once signed token access is wired
api route guard inventory represents the public receipt service as guard evidence for the receipt route
api route guard inventory classifies the public receipt service when token gate and contact redaction are present
api route guard inventory flags a public receipt service missing token gate and public contact redaction
api route guard inventory requires settings module entitlement for the organization self-service API
api route guard inventory classifies tenant asset reads and inventory item media writes separately
api route guard inventory does not flag fresh security.txt or contact-safe public receipt shaping
api route guard inventory includes canonical well-known security.txt as an intentional public route
api route guard inventory flags security.txt contact fields that are not disclosure URIs
api route guard inventory parses report arguments
